convention: world = source_orientation * package_to_source * package_point + origin; MY negates x, MX negates y

SCHOTTKY.note: Verified against the actual legacy package pins, not the handoff's reversed anode coordinates.

EXTERNALLY_CONTROLLED_SWITCH.note: Control pin moved independently; keep the contact pins aligned. Wire endpoints follow the current control terminal.

TRANSMISSION_LINE.note: Reference pins moved independently; keep the signal pins aligned.

IO_PORT_SYMBOL.note: The pin remains at the origin; the package now draws its body behind that pin.

D_FLIP_FLOP.note: D and CLK exchanged positions; keep the output side aligned.

D_FLIP_FLOP_Q_ONLY.note: Keep the input-side centroid aligned; Q moved to the center.

ADDER.note: Pins moved independently; retain orientation and attach routes to terminal references.

MULTIPLIER.note: Pins moved independently; retain orientation and attach routes to terminal references.
